note: The attacker-controlled regex pattern is parsed into the node tree; the capture group (a) inside the look-behind (?<=(a){0}) is registered so scan_env.mem_env[1].mem_node points to the BAG_MEMORY node.
tune_look_behind computes the character length of the look-behind body (a){0}; the quantifier {0} makes the body provably empty.

NODE_QUANT with lower == upper == 0 returns min=0, max=0, min_is_sure=TRUE without ever visiting the capture-group body (a), so the capture inside the empty quantifier is invisible to the emptiness check.

The empty look-behind optimization resets the anchor node to an empty string node, freeing the whole look-behind body subtree (quantifier + capture group (a)) without checking that capture group 1 is back-referenced; mem_env[1].mem_node is left dangling.
onig_node_reset_empty delegates to node_reset_str which first frees the current node body via node_free_body.

node_free_body on the ANCHOR node recursively frees NODE_BODY: the {0} quantifier node and the BAG_MEMORY capture node (a). The freed BAG_MEMORY node is still referenced by scan_env.mem_env[1].mem_node.
For the second look-behind (?<=\1), tune_look_behind computes the length of the body, which is a back-reference node to the already-freed capture group 1.
Node-length calculation for the back-reference dereferences mem_env[1].mem_node, which points to the freed BAG_MEMORY node -> heap-use-after-free.
